questions.q_en: If ÷ is interchanged with + and x is interchanged with - , then which of the following expression is correct?
questions.solution_en:
If ÷ is interchanged with + and x is interchanged with - , then the equations will be:

Option (a) 15 x 45 ÷ 9 + 18 - 3 = 60

= 75 + 18 - 3

= 93 - 3

= 90. So, option (a) is incorrect.

Option (b) 22 - 11 + 2 ÷ 13 x 4 = 173

= 22 - 11 + 0.615

= 22.615 - 11

= 11.615

So, option (b) is incorrect.

Option (c) 73 + 89 - 54 ÷ 6 x 12 = 54

= 73 + 89 - 108

= 162 - 108

= 54. So, option (c) is correct.

Option (d) 42 ÷ 19 x 26 + 2 - 4 = 29

= 57.47 + 2 - 4

= 59.47 - 4

= 55.47

So, option (d) is incorrect.

questions.q_en: If A denotes '+', B denotes 'x', C denotes '÷', D denotes '=' and E denotes ' - ', then which of the following equations will be correct?
questions.solution_en:
If A denotes '+', B denotes 'x', C denotes '÷', D denotes '=' and E denotes ' - ', then the equations will be:

Option (a) 69 - 23 x 12 = 18 ÷ 3 + 45

So, 69 - 276 = 6 + 45

So, 69 - 276 = 51

So, -207 ≠ 51

So, the equation is incorrect.

Option (b) 69 + 23 - 12 = 18 x 3 ÷ 45

So, 69 + 23 - 12 = 1.2

So, 69 + 23 - 12 = 1.2

So, 92 - 12 = 1.2

So, 80 ≠ 1.2

So, the equation is incorrect.

Option (c) 69 ÷ 23 - 12 + 18 x 3 = 45

So, 3 - 12 + 18 x 3 = 45

So, 3 - 12 + 54 = 45

So, 57 - 12 = 45

So, 45 = 45

So, the equation is correct.

Option (d) 69 ÷ 23 x 12 + 18 - 3 = 45

So, 3 x 12 + 18 - 3 = 45

So, 36 + 18 - 3 = 45

So, 54 - 3 = 45

So, 51 ≠ 45

So, the equation is incorrect.

(68)2 - 62 = 41 ÷ 5 + 48

4624 - 36 = 8.2 + 48

4588 ≠ 56.2

So, the equation is not balanced.
